mission: Fix read-only diagnostic yuyu-f1-approval-receipt (owner questions 2026-10-20 09:46Z): it counted a mapping as reused when created more than 5 s before its group's review, but a new mapping's created_at is its approval transaction's start, about 7 s before reviewed_at in the batch-2 apply, so all 500 read as reused. Staging only; no write, collector, rollout, migration, source request, price, identity, mapping, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change.
